items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Miles Davis band--we had and Trane, Red, Paul and Philly Joe

ctx.x: Interesting thing, not to cut you off, but just to interject something--it's like I hear lot of the young people, especially since I been going around doing this lecture thing. If you talk about Miles Davis, then you talk about Miles' band with Herbie Hancock and Tony Williams., and Wayne Shorter. I tell them 'ya'll 'aint heard the Miles Davis band.' Miles Davis band--we had and Trane, Red, Paul and Philly Joe--well them guys used to scare you to death.
